description.value:
Your constitution is the stuff of legend.

You become proficient in Constitution saving throws; if you already had that proficiency, you gain expertise in it instead.

When an enhanced healing effect — such as a power or a medpac — would restore hit points to you, it restores no less than half your character level plus your Constitution modifier; if that minimum would exceed the maximum the effect could otherwise restore, you instead recover that effect's normal maximum.

You can add your Constitution modifier to death saving throws you make.
